rationale.A: ~1.2 km in traffic (Helsinginkatu, Runeberginkatu with tram rails), several unsignalled Sturenkatu crossings, 15 lights
rationale.B: Vallila valley and Central Park paths almost end to end; only ~170 m on Runeberginkatu; 6 lights for +1 min
rationale.C: Same Vallila valley/Central Park route, but Pasila leg runs beside Ratapihantie/Asemapäällikönkatu with extra lights
rationale.E: Like C: same corridor, Pasila leg beside Ratapihantie
rationale.F: Long shore path, then ~860 m in traffic on Helsinginkatu incl. tram rails, 15 lights
rationale.G: Most traffic of all: Hämeentie and Helsinginkatu (tram) in the carriageway, 16 lights
rationale.H: Calm park paths, avoids Runeberginkatu tram but ~460 m on Pohjoinen Hesperiankatu (mostly 30 km/h); +3 min

notes: B-E are the same Vallila valley/Pasila/Central Park route; C/E take a parallel Pasila alignment (~700 m) one block over. B saves 9 lights and removes most mixed traffic for +1 min, so it covers both cards.
